messages.subject: Error Installation of package
parts:
Hello everyone

I'm trying to install FIELDimageR, but I get the following error:

ERROR: dependencies 'EBImage', 'attempt', 'config', 'DT', 'fftwtools', 'git2r', 'DescTools', 'rgdal', 'spatialEco' are not available for package 'FIELDimageR'
* removing 'C:/Users/Memo/Documents/R/win-library/4.0/FIELDimageR'
Warning in install.packages :
   installation of package ‘FIELDimageR_0.3.3.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status


I have already tried all the ways suggested in this post

https://community.opendronemap.org/t/about-the-fieldimager-category/4130?u=amithaldar87

And none of these suggestions have helped me, if someone has the same problem and could help me solve it, I would greatly appreciate it.

Greetings.

Jorge

Hi Jorge
Have you tried just to run these to lines one at a time

Kind regards
Martin
